dedupe_keys.name: repurposed lifepo4 battery charge and discharge profiles

description: This OSF project publishes experimental records for repurposing C-Life 40138 lithium iron phosphate battery cells for home energy storage. The research team provides separate folders for repurposed and broken cells, a workbook of key values, battery specifications and a module-disassembly document. Numbered cell folders contain CSV files for two test procedures, and the project explicitly links the associated UL 1974 charge-and-discharge study. The own page applies CC BY 4.0 with free access. Coverage is a device-testing campaign, not a geographic operating fleet; the complete cell count and temporal sampling interval were not established from the inspected landing page. These profiles can calibrate second-life storage assumptions and component responses in simulations such as model-virtual-battery-aggregator. A caveat is that histories and failure conditions differ between cells and need checking before pooling results. A published experimental trace also does not certify another battery's safety. No measurements or technical-document files were downloaded.
